description: Deploy the preview environment through the governed pipeline (policy check → deploy → poll → smoke → evidence). Default policy allows previews autonomously. For the zero-config instant preview (no manifest/provider key) use openpouch_deploy instead. On success the live URL is returned at top-level `url`, plus a plain-language `summary` to relay to your human.
